title: STATUS — Sports Store Deployments
summary: Live project dashboard tracking current deployment state, ownership boundaries, verification levels, and open risk/finding work items for the sports-store Helm/GitOps repo.
notes: Manifest declared PRD and is authoritative; heuristics alone would read this as DOC (dashboard prose). Treated as requirement material per manifest: open work items are the primary requirements.

work_items.statement: Metrics not scraped: ServiceMonitor selectors expect app.kubernetes.io/name: <service> but Services carry app.kubernetes.io/name: sports-store from the shared helper, so no Service matches and Prometheus scrapes nothing. Selector/label match must be corrected.

MongoDB has no persistence: datadir is emptyDir on a Deployment with no PVC, so data does not survive restart/upgrade/rollback/uninstall. Flagged as a brief violation; depends on Sean for EBS StorageClass.
mongo-init ConfigMap renders with a blank namespace because .Values.namespace.name is missing, causing wrong-namespace placement on a raw kubectl apply without -n.
Argo CD Application name renders as cloudcart due to a duplicate name: key in argocd-app.yaml; must be corrected to the sports-store application name.
Frontend is not chart-managed: no Deployment or Service renders for it. Intent must be confirmed with the team and the chart aligned to that decision.

app-secrets and Mongo URIs come from AWS Secrets Manager sports-store/production via ESO using IRSA sports-store-external-secrets-role in us-east-1. Missing ESO operator, secret, properties, or IRSA leads to pods not ready, ALB 503, and demo failure. All *_MONGO_URI values must resolve sports-store-mongodb:27017.
/metrics endpoints must be exposed on the services' http ports; tracked via fix/ci-instrumentator PRs.
ALB controller install, EBS StorageClass needed for R2, and implementation of the declared required extension.
Frontend/domain reachability is only a status signal; full E2E (frontend to gateway to each API to data layer) is unverified and must never be conflated with reachability in any report.
Secrets must stay reference-only in git; any leaked value is an immediate fix.

resolved_items: F1 — image tags: all 6 app images now 0.1.0-<7char-hash>, no latest
F3 — ingress routing: backend routes to Service gateway:80 in sports-store
F4 — ServiceMonitors render (6 emitted), but selectors mismatch (see R1)
OIDC regression resolved across all 7 service repos
Deployments restructure landed on main (#17/#18), superseding the app-secrets empty stringData item
